title: A Central TermAl restart can kill a remote runner's foreground launcher run mid-gate, leaving it interrupted without a terminal result
outcome: A restart of the Central TermAl host does not end a launcher run that a federated runner session started in the foreground, or, if it can, the run is recorded with a clear interruption cause and the runner and scheduler are told; restart guidance names foreground gate runs on runners as work a restart would cut.
acceptance: A Central TermAl restart can kill a remote runner's foreground launcher run mid-gate, leaving it interrupted without a terminal result is done
